svg.title: Skill 05 - Interactive rebase
svg.desc: Animation: git rebase -i HEAD~4 opens a to-do list; pick is changed to fixup for three messy commits, and they melt into the first commit, leaving one clean commit.

g.text: p pick · r reword · e edit · s squash · f fixup · d drop
Four commits, one real change: a feature, a WIP, a typo fix, more WIP.
git rebase -i HEAD~4 opens a to-do list: change pick → fixup.
Git replays the list and melts each fixup into the commit above it.
One clean commit with the same final content. Tidy up before you share.
